fullContentHtml:
SBI Clerk JA Backlog Mains Admit Card 2026 – Full Details

State Bank of India (SBI) has released the Mains Admit Card for the Post of Junior Associates Clerk. This recruitment was released for 1538 posts. Applications for the SBI Clerk JA Backlog Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 07 August 2026 to 27 August 2026. The mains examination is going to conducted on 29 October 2026. Candidates who had qualified for pre exam can download their SBI Clerk JA Backlog Mains Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 07 August 2026
  • Last Date : 27 August 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 27 August 2026
  • Pre Exam Date : 16 September 2026
  • Admit Card : 09 September 2026
  • Pre Result : 17 October 2026
  • Mains Exam Date : 29 October 2026
  • Mains Admit Card : 19 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 750/-
  • SC, ST, PH : 0/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

  • Download Mains Admit Card
  • Download Pre Result
  • Download Pre Admit Card

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is SBI Clerk JA Backlog Mains Admit Card 2026?

SBI Clerk JA Backlog Mains Admit Card 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
